title: RevalidationVerdict
description: An independent second-opinion re-verification of ONE finding a prior scan already confirmed. Emitted by `vash validate` (Phase 6) — a fresh, read-only agent session that actively pursues the OPPOSITE of the scan's verdict (VVAH s6 second-opinion stance) before agreeing with it. Cannot emit new findings.

verdict.description: validated: independently re-confirmed. failed: actively disproved (an overturned false positive). needs_review: could not be decisively settled statically.

confidence.description: 0-10. 8-10 means you actively searched for the opposite verdict and could not support it (VVAH s6). A validated verdict below the pipeline's min_confidence gate is downgraded to needs_review.

agrees_with_scan.description: Your best-effort self-assessment of whether this verdict matches the scan's original verdict. The pipeline recomputes this deterministically afterward from the final verdict — it is not trusted blindly — but still reason honestly here.

rationale.description: Must engage with the evidence you independently found (call sites checked, defenses read, which gate applied) — not restate the finding's description.

alternative_explanation.description: Mandatory in spirit even when verdict = validated: the rival hypothesis you actively pursued and ruled out (if failed, this IS your false-positive case; if validated, the false-positive theory that did not hold up; if needs_review, what remains unresolved).
